title: Reagan's staff cut 'tear down this wall' twice

tellings.quote: >> The staff took it out of the speech not once but twice.

plain: Before Ronald Reagan, then the US president, gave his 1987 speech in Berlin, his staff twice cut the famous line "tear down this wall" from the draft, and Reagan put it back. John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy who served under Reagan, tells this, naming the speechwriter Peter Robinson and a book of Reagan's own writings called In His Own Hand: "The staff took it out of the speech not once but twice." He tells it to show how Reagan sometimes overruled his own advisers.
